description_en: Changes the billing method of a cloud desktop to subscription or pay-as-you-go
description_zh: 将云电脑的付费类型转为包年包月或按量付费
kebab_example: aliyun ecd modify-desktop-charge-type --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --charge-type PrePaid --period 1 --period-unit Month --auto-pay false --desktop-id ecd-gx2x1dhsmucyy0000 --promotion-id 500038360030000 --use-duration 1 --reseller-owner-uid 1 --api-version 2020-09-30 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ModifyDesktopChargeType

parameters.description_en: The region ID. You can call the [DescribeRegions](~~196646~~) operation to query the regions supported by Elastic Desktop Service.
parameters.description_zh: 地域ID。可以调用[DescribeRegions](~~196646~~)获取无影云电脑支持的地域列表。
parameters.help_en: The region ID. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/196646.html operation to query the regions supported by Elastic Desktop Service
parameters.help_zh: 地域ID。可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/196646.html获取无影云电脑支持的地域列表
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.description_zh: 要转换的目标计费方式。
parameters.help_zh: 要转换的目标计费方式
parameters.name: charge_type

parameters.description_en:
The subscription duration. This parameter is required only when you set the `ChargeType` parameter to `PrePaid`. The unit of the duration is specified by the `PeriodUnit` parameter.

- If you set the `PeriodUnit` parameter to `Week`, you can set this parameter only to 1.

- If you set the `PeriodUnit` parameter to `Month`, you can set this parameter to 1, 2, 3, or 6.

- If you set the `PeriodUnit` parameter to `Year`, you can set this parameter to 1, 2, 3, 4, or 5.
parameters.description_zh:
转换成包年包月计费方式时，云电脑的购买时长。单位由`PeriodUnit`指定。当参数`ChargeType`取值为`PrePaid`时才生效，且为必选值。

- 如果`PeriodUnit`为`Week`，该参数的取值范围为1。
- 如果`PeriodUnit`为`Month`，该参数的取值范围为1、2、3、6。
- 如果`PeriodUnit`为`Year`，该参数的取值范围为1、2、3、4、5。
